message.content:
p7c -t rebuild -i index -d dryrun -l force

Flag breakdown:
- `-t rebuild` — tells p7c to run the rebuild job type.
- `-i index` — specifies the target is the index (not a full rebuild or vacuum).
- `-d dryrun` — runs the command without applying any actual changes; it only validates the plan and reports what would be done.
- `-l force` — forces locking on the target table, preventing concurrent reads/writes during the operation.
